palindrome:
Able was I ere I saw Elba. This is one of the shortest well-known palindromes in English.

However, if you want something longer and more creative, here's an example:

In a meadow under misty skies,
Came a curious cat who loved to spy.
He'd peek through peepholes on old barn doors,
And watch the world with twinkling eyes and showers.
One day, as he wandered from tree to tree,
He saw a sight that made his heart freeze:
A fish swimming slowly in the clear stream,
Its scales shimmering like tiny sapphires gleaming.

The cat purred contentedly, feeling quite serene,
Then noticed something strange beneath the green leaves—
Another fish, just as curious and keen,
Who seemed to recognize the other with a serene gleam.
For fish don't speak our language, of course,
But they can understand each other, even though their thoughts may be obscure.

And so the two swam together, hand in hand,
Through the stream's cool waters, side by side,
In perfect harmony and friendship grand,
In a world of misty skies and nature's pride.
Their peaceful journey became a legend to tell,
Of two fish who found each other, day by day, so well.
